title: Betelgeuse brightness, normal vs. dimmest recorded (percent of normal)

source.name: The 'Great Dimming' of Betelgeuse
source.publisher: AAVSO photometric monitoring data; Montarges et al., 'A dusty veil shading Betelgeuse during its Great Dimming', Nature, 2021

notes: Betelgeuse's apparent magnitude climbed from its typical ~0.5 to about 1.6 by February 2020 -- the faintest it had been recorded in roughly 150 years of photometric monitoring, equivalent to roughly a third of its normal brightness.
